title: Scenario
description: Declarative input to the ScenariiPlayer. Drives end-to-end generation of a typed Requirements project through three coordinated FSMs (ProjectLifecycle / PerFeature / PerAc). Hand-written; will be regenerated via ts-json-schema-generator once the types file is frozen.

$schemaVersion.description: Pinned schema version. Replay safety — a scenario authored against vN is rejected by vN+1 until explicitly migrated.

title.description: Human-readable title shown in `scenario list` and `scenario inspect`.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what the scenario demonstrates.

style.description: RequirementStyle to use: one of 'default'|'industrial'|'lean'|'agile'|'kanban' OR a module path that default-exports a RequirementStyle.

seeds.description: Wizard inputs replayed in declaration order. 3-10 entries each (soft convention, not schema-enforced).

targets.description: Optional runtime targets — AI prompts, expected artifacts, timing budget.

aiPrompts.description: Per-AC prompt template for `--ai` mode. Key format: '<FEAT-ID>.<acName>'.

expectedArtifacts.description: File paths (relative to cwd) that MUST exist after playback. Asserted post-run; failure fails the scenario.

totalMs.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole scenario in ms.

RequirementSeed.description: Partial RequirementSpec. Fields omitted are filled by the wizard's defaults / style template.

id.description: Requirement id. Same pattern as REQUIREMENT_ID_PATTERN in src/cli/types.ts.

kind.description: Style-vocabulary entry (validated at playback time against the chosen style).

statement.description: EARS statement (one of 6 patterns). Validated against the style's statementPatterns at playback.

satisfiedByFeatureIds.description: Forward references to FeatureSeed.id entries. Validated by scenario-validate against seeds.features.

FeatureSeed.description: Partial FeatureSpec with ACs and their expected test levels.

id.description: Feature id. Same pattern as FEATURE_ID_PATTERN in src/cli/types.ts.

satisfies.description: Forward references to RequirementSeed.id entries. Validated by scenario-validate against seeds.requirements.

name.description: camelCase AC method name. Same pattern as AC_NAME_PATTERN.

expects.description: TestLevel enum values; at least one required.
